description: Run `go mod tidy` after gomod updates. renovate-preset extends this preset instead of setting the option inline because postUpdateOptions is a mergeable array: a consumer packageRule can only add to it, never remove gomodTidy. A consumer whose go.mod has no Go package (a Hugo module) lists this preset in ignorePresets, because tidy cannot see Hugo imports and deletes their requires and go.sum entries.

packageRules.description: go mod tidy after every gomod update
